description: First time on the market in 30 years, this rare Encino Hills estate offers a unique opportunity on one of the largest lots in the neighborhood. Once owned by a Hollywood producer, the gated property sits on approx. 1.55 acres with serene canyon views, privacy, and lush grounds. Located in the highly sought after Lanai Road Elementary School district, it is ideal for young families or buyers looking to build a dream estate. The home features hardwood floors, formal living and dining rooms, family room with built-ins, gourmet kitchen with granite countertops, downstairs guest suite/office, and spacious primary suite with dual walk-in closets and spa bath. Resort-style grounds include pool, spa, BBQ area, and large gated play yard. Exceptional setting offering privacy, security, and tremendous future upside in prime Encino Hills.
